title: Cut an open-top square box
statement:
A square sheet has side length $6([$a])$ inches. Find the corner cut size that maximizes box volume.

[__________]{a}
hints: A cut removes $2x$ from each base dimension.
Compare its only interior critical point against the zero-volume endpoints.
solution: $V'=(6[$a]-2x)(6[$a]-6x)$, so $x=[$a]$ gives positive volume and the endpoints $0,3[$a]$ give zero.

feedback.message: Compare its only interior critical point against the zero-volume endpoints.
